attributes.title: [Metrics vLLM] Overview
attributes.description: vLLM inference servers: load and queueing, KV cache and prefix cache, token throughput, finished requests and latency.

params.markdown:
## [Metrics vLLM] Overview

Metrics scraped from the vLLM `/metrics` endpoint.

- **Load**: requests running and waiting, KV cache usage, preemptions
- **Throughput**: prompt and generation tokens per second
- **Latency**: time to first token, inter-token latency, end to end and queue time

A growing waiting queue together with a full KV cache and preemptions means the server needs more KV cache or more replicas.

TS metrics-vllm.metrics-*
| WHERE data_stream.dataset == "vllm.metrics"
| STATS hits = SUM(RATE(vllm.prefix_cache.hits.count)), queries = SUM(RATE(vllm.prefix_cache.queries.count))
| EVAL hit_rate = CASE(queries > 0, hits / queries, 0.0)
| KEEP hit_rate

| SORT time_bucket ASC
